items.detail: tests/sim (npm run sim): salvage yield, hauls-to-afford for every upgrade, campaign, fuel range, storm damage, voyages, exploit checks

items.title: Simulation: pacing between purchases (difficulty spikes)
items.detail: commission Scrap Trimaran: 34 actions vs ≤11 before

items.title: Simulation: the Stormwall as the final barrier
items.detail: Driftholm → Meridian Spire under the real loop: Ironwake arrived in 12/12 runs, 7.9 s inside the wall on average, losing 2.2-9.7% hull (stock sail to Cutter Rig, with and without armour). The Trimaran was swamped trying in 3/3 runs. For a final barrier the crossing is short and nearly free once you own the right boat; whether that is the intent is a design call.

items.title: Simulation: no economy exploits through crafting, fuel or repair
items.detail: craft Refine Fuel then sell: ok; craft Hull Patch Kit then sell: ok; craft Alloy Plate then sell: ok; craft Engine Parts then sell: ok; craft Stitch Sailcloth then sell: ok; craft Strip Wire then sell: ok; buy fuel at driftholm: ok; buy fuel at hollow: ok; buy fuel at helios: ok; repair 35 hull at a dock vs a patch kit: ok; salvage respawn follows the device clock: EXPLOIT

findings.title: Difficulty/pacing spike: commission Scrap Trimaran
findings.detail: 34 sourcing actions for this step vs at most 11 for any earlier step (campaign, winch 2/3).

findings.title: The Stormwall barely scratches the Ironwake
findings.detail: Driftholm → Meridian Spire under the real loop: Ironwake arrived in 12/12 runs, 7.9 s inside the wall on average, losing 2.2-9.7% hull (stock sail to Cutter Rig, with and without armour). The Trimaran was swamped trying in 3/3 runs. For a final barrier the crossing is short and nearly free once you own the right boat; whether that is the intent is a design call.

findings.title: An extra winch hit sometimes pays nothing
findings.detail: The Sunken Tower: 1/3 → 15.6g vs 2/3 → 15.4g; The Box Yard: 1/3 → 23.7g vs 2/3 → 24.8g; Hollow Underfloors: 1/3 → 27.7g vs 2/3 → 25.8g. Loot rolls round to the same number for these hit counts, so landing the extra pull in the green earns no more on average.

findings.title: Exploit: salvage respawn follows the device clock
findings.detail: Salvage.ready compares Date.now() with the saved haul time, so changing the phone’s clock skips respawn timers. Severity is a design call (single-player).

findings.title: No progression dead ends found
findings.detail: Every one of the 21 upgrades and vessels became affordable and was bought through the game in every seed at every winch skill (hits_1, hits_2, hits_3).

findings.title: Captain's Log in the campaign stops at g_raiders
findings.detail: Completed: g_salvage → g_engine → g_crew → g_trimaran → g_helios → g_meridian. The raider goal needs real-time combat, which the simulation does not play; nothing after it can complete here (purchases are not gated by goals).

findings.title: Storm damage
findings.detail: A full storm (storm 1.0) costs the stock Skiff 57.6 hull/min (swamped from full in 1.0 min); the Trimaran 57.6 hull/min (1.7 min). Riveted Armour cuts it by 45.0%. Below storm 0.4 there is no damage.

findings.title: Crafting margins are small
findings.detail: Hull Patch Kit: +2g (20%); Alloy Plate: +2g (11%); Engine Parts: +3g (14%); Strip Wire: +1g (11%). Not worth farming.

findings.title: Sailing never needs tacking
findings.detail: Stock Skiff: 6.5 m/s on a beam reach, 5.8 downwind, 2.9 dead into the wind (45%). Every boat can sail straight upwind at under half speed; wind shapes speed, not routes.
